limitations: No leakage-free 2018/2022 production replays are available yet; historical Brier/log-loss metrics are therefore withheld.
Candidate-quality effects beyond incumbency are not separately estimated.
Third-party and ranked-choice transfer behaviour is simplified in the chamber model.
Presidential-approval and economic-context feeds are not yet validated production inputs; FEC finance and external-forecaster data are displayed only in the separate non-model context layer.
The nowcast and election-day forecast do not yet use a separate explicit time-evolution process.
Correlated national error is simulated, but cross-race correlation remains deliberately simple rather than a full geographic covariance model.
